claim: Because of the high number of false and counterfeit documents, Italy suspended the validity of all work nulla osta issued to citizens of some countries, including Bangladesh, until verified (Embassy communique, 16 October 2024)
quote: Due to the high number of false and counterfeit documents, the Italian Government has suspended the validity of all "Nulla Osta" (work authorizations) released in favour of citizens of some countries, including Bangladesh, until due verification is completed.

claim: Under Law Decree 145/2024 the Embassy issues the work visa only after the SUI in Italy confirms the suspended nulla osta has been verified
quote: the Embassy will issue the work visa only after receiving confirmation from the provincial immigration office in Italy

claim: Suspended work nulla osta do not expire while awaiting confirmation; other visa types (family, study, business, tourism) were not affected
quote: The processing of other types of visas (such as family, study, business and tourism) remains unchanged.

claim: By 27 May 2025 over 7,000 suspended work visa cases had been issued or rejected after nulla osta re-examination
quote: over 7000 work visas have already been either issued or rejected

claim: Over 70% of entries on the Embassy's 2025 work-visa webform contained fake or invalid nulla osta
quote: over 70% of the entries contain fake or invalid "Nulla Osta" documents

claim: VFS Global handles only the logistics of visa applications and has no say in decisions or document checks
quote: VFS Global is tasked only with the logistical process of visa applications, and holds no authority over the decision-making

claim: Neither the Embassy nor VFS asks for money beyond the published fees or holds a passport against the applicant's will; such cases should be reported to the authorities
quote: Neither the Embassy, nor VFS will ever ask applicants for money except for publicly listed fees, or hold an applicant's passport against their will.

claim: The Embassy tells applicants who use an agency to check its reputation, take a receipt for every payment and know every document presented in their name
quote: ask for a receipt for every sum they pay, and be aware of each and every document that is being presented in their name

claim: Applicants must give contact details so VFS can reach them directly, not through an intermediary
quote: make sure that VFS is always able to contact them directly and not through an intermediary

claim: In September 2025, 944 confirmed nulla osta for Bangladeshis whose holders had not applied for a visa were listed on the VFS website, with walk-in days at the VFS centres in Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet
quote: Holders of such Nulla Osta are invited to present themselves on Tuesday, 16th September at one of the VFS Visa Application Centres in Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet

claim: 944 nulla osta had been confirmed by the SUIs for Bangladeshis who had not yet applied for the visa
quote: A total of 944 Nulla Osta have been confirmed by the competent Provincial Immigration Offices in Italy

claim: Holders of a confirmed nulla osta register on the VFS work-visa portal vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/ to get an appointment
quote: register in the dedicated work visa portal at https://vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/

claim: Nulla osta code L/N (Article 27, the 'carta blu' for highly qualified workers) is outside the quota and reserved for highly qualified jobs; holding one does not guarantee a visa
quote: Holding a valid Nulla Osta code L/N does not guarantee the issuance of this type of visa

claim: Very few Bangladeshi applicants for L/N visas have succeeded; most were not highly qualified
quote: Very few applicants of this type of visa in Bangladesh have so far been successful.

claim: The Embassy warns against brokers who promise a 'Nulla Osta L/N code - carta blu'
quote: We advise the public not to become prey of agents and illegal brokers who promise a "Nulla Osta L/N code - carta blu"

claim: TUIR art. 12 (tax deductions for family dependants) is repealed by Legislative Decree 117 of 19 June 2026, in the text in force from 1 January 2027
quote: Testo in vigore dal: 1-1-2027 aggiornamenti all'articolo Art. 12 ((PROVVEDIMENTO ABROGATO DAL D.LGS. 19 GIUGNO 2026, N. 117))

claim: In April 2026 a Libyan court jailed four human traffickers for up to 22 years
quote: Libyan court jails four human traffickers for up to 22 years, attorney general says

claim: Italian work visa fee in Bangladesh: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116), or BDT 12,600 (EUR 90) in some cases
quote: Work | Visa Fee | BDT 16240/12600 | EUR 116/90

claim: VFS Global service charge for an Italian work visa: BDT 5,320 (EUR 38), including 15% VAT
quote: Work | VFS Global Service Charge | BDT 5320 | EUR 38

claim: Bank draft charge for an Italian visa at VFS: BDT 270
quote: Work | Bank Draft Charge | BDT 270

claim: Fingerprints (biometrics) are mandatory for all work visa applicants
quote: Work: Biometric is mandatory for all applicants.

claim: VFS fees are paid in cash only, at the Embassy's rate of EUR 1 = Tk 140; the VFS charge includes 15% VAT
quote: Exchange rate - 1 Euro = 140 VFS service fee is inclusive 15% VAT Mode of Payment: Cash Only

claim: The VFS charge covers SMS and email notices, photocopies, photo booth and help filling in the form
quote: Logistic fee includes free SMS, e-mail notification, photocopy, photobooth, form filling assistance

claim: Family reunion visa: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116) visa fee plus BDT 5,320 (EUR 38) VFS charge and BDT 270 bank draft; children aged 0-12 give no fingerprints
quote: Family Re-Union | Visa Fee | BDT 16240 | EUR 116

claim: Children aged 0 to 12 are exempt from fingerprints for a family reunion visa
quote: Biometric Exemption- Children between 0 to 12 years old are exempted from giving fingerprints.

claim: Student visa fee: BDT 7,000 (EUR 50) or free depending on course length; the VFS charge (BDT 5,320) is waived when the visa is free
quote: Study | Student Visa Fee | BDT 7000/0 | EUR 50/0

claim: The VFS service charge is waived when the Embassy grants the visa free
quote: Note: VFS Global service charge is waived when visa fee is gratis by embassy.

claim: Self-employment (lavoro autonomo) visa: BDT 16,240 (EUR 116) visa fee plus BDT 5,320 (EUR 38) VFS charge
quote: Lavoro Autonomo | Visa Fee | BDT 16240 | EUR 116

claim: Holders of a work nulla osta issued or re-confirmed in 2025 must register on the VFS portal vfseu.mioot.com/forms/ITABDE/ and upload the nulla osta copy the employer provides
quote: Those who are in possession of a work "Nulla Osta" issued in 2025 or re-confirmed in 2025 must register in the dedicated VFS Global web portal

claim: The applicant uploads a copy of the 2025 nulla osta, which the employer in Italy can provide
quote: It is necessary to upload copy of the 2025 Nulla Osta, that can be provided by the employer in Italy.

claim: The Embassy verifies the nulla osta and gives an appointment within a few days of registration
quote: The Embassy will verify the validity of Nulla Osta and provide an appointment in the next few days after the registration.

claim: Holders of a 2023-2024 nulla osta who already applied must wait for the review in Italy; VFS contacts them afterwards
quote: Those who are in possession of a Nulla Osta issued in 2023-2024 and submitted a visa application already, must wait until a review of their Nulla Osta is completed by the Immigration Office in Italy.

claim: On 31 October 2025 Italy returned 4 Bangladeshis without permission to stay; 2 had arrived from Libya without a visa a month before
quote: On October 31, Italian Authorities returned from Italy 4 Bangladeshi citizens without authorization to stay.

claim: Over 120 Bangladeshis were returned from Italy in 2025 (to 3 November)
quote: Over 120 Bangladeshi citizens have already been repatriated to Bangladesh in 2025

claim: The Embassy warns that paying traffickers, brokers and dalals to enter without a proper visa, or with a fraudulent one, leads to immediate repatriation
quote: Paying traffickers, brokers, and dalals to enter Italy without a proper visa - or with a fraudulent visa - is illegal and will lead to immediate repatriation procedures.
